title: DLT Consensus Partition & Recovery Simulator
description: Simulate network partitions and Byzantine fault scenarios for Hyperledger Fabric (Raft), Besu (QBFT), R3 Corda, and Canton. Generate a platform-specific numbered recovery runbook, transaction re-verification manifest, and governance voting worksheet. Client-side. Zero PII.
